name: Catch the Bunny
source:
A visual novel about a college student who has to now live with his new step-sister. It's up to you to decide whether your relationship will grow into more than a brother-to-sister relationship and the way that will happen.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/catchthecarrot]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一部关于一名大学生现在必须与他的新继姐妹住在一起的视觉小说。你们的关系是否会发展为超越兄弟姐妹的关系以及如何发展，都由你决定。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/catchthecarrot]Patreon[/url]]
